generate_audio_from_prompt: run the MusicLDMPipeline to generate audio waveforms from a text prompt using diffusion
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLAP text embeddings using the MusicLDMPipeline tokenizer and text encoder
convert_mel_spectrogram_to_waveform: convert a mel spectrogram tensor to an audio waveform using the SpeechT5HifiGan vocoder
score_waveforms_by_text_similarity: score and rank generated audio waveforms by their cosine similarity to input text prompts
enable_cpu_offload_for_pipeline: enable model CPU offload on the MusicLDMPipeline to reduce GPU memory usage
